name: founder-onboarding
description: First-run AgentOS setup. Capture owner profile, first project, routines, integration status. Mark complete when memory/owner.md is filled and at least one memory/projects/<slug>/ exists.

title: Capture founder profile (memory/owner.md)
description: Walk through the YAML template. Skip any field you can't fill in 30 seconds — come back to it later.

title: Add first project
description: Pick the most active project. Capture: company name + slug, what it does, current quarter goals, North Star metric, runway. Save to memory/projects/<slug>/index.md.

title: Configure routines
description: Confirm: daily brief time, weekly review time, pre-meeting nudge minutes. Update memory/owner.md routines section.

title: Test integrations
description: If Gmail/Calendar MCPs are configured, run a read-test. If not, note in memory/owner.md.integrations and explain what's available without them.
